# Programming / Rust

| [rust-borrow-checker-error-explainer](rust-borrow-checker-error-explainer/SKILL.md) | Explain and fix Rust borrow-checker, ownership, move and lifetime compiler errors: E0382 use of moved value, E0499 cannot borrow as mutable more than once, E0502 also borrowed as immutable, E0505, E0506, E0503, E0507 cannot move out of index/Rc/reference, E0515 return reference to local, E0597 does not live long enough, E0716 temporary value dropped while borrowed, E0373 closure may outlive (spawn needs move), E0521 borrowed data escapes, E0384, E0596, E0594, E0381, E0713, 'lifetime may not live long enough', RefCell 'already borrowed: BorrowMutError' panics.
